newsitem.title: USA: Carter-Wallace names Levine president, COO.
newsitem.headline: Carter-Wallace names Levine president, COO.

text.p: Carter-Wallace Inc., which markets toiletries, proprietary drugs and pet products, Friday named Ralph Levine president and chief operating officer, effective April 1.
Levine, vice president, secretary and general counsel for Carter-Wallace, will succeed Daniel Black, who will retire on March 31. Levine, 60, has been with the New York-based company for 34 years.
Paul Veteri will become executive vice president and chief financial officer as of April 1, the company said. Veteri, 54, is now vice president-finance and chief financial officer.
Carter-Wallace's stock rose 12.5 cents to $12 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
